technology.title: Inside the engine
technology.subtitle: Our trading system analyzes market trends, signals, and risk to find the best opportunities. It adapts to changing conditions automatically.

trend.title: Multi-Timeframe Trend Analysis
trend.description: Uses ROC (Rate of Change) and EMA indicators to identify the overall trend direction and strength across different timeframes.

benefits.1: Analyzes trends across multiple timeframes simultaneously (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d)
benefits.2: Uses Rate of Change (ROC) to measure momentum strength and direction
benefits.3: Exponential Moving Averages (EMA) identify primary trend direction
benefits.4: Filters out market noise while preserving significant trend movements
benefits.5: Provides trend strength scoring from 0-100 for position confidence

trend.alert: Our trend analysis engine examines price movements across multiple timeframes to identify the dominant market direction, filtering out short-term noise while capturing significant trend changes.

signals.title: OBOS Signals
signals.description: Detects overbought/oversold conditions using RSI and pivot points to find potential entry opportunities when momentum diverges from price.

benefits.1: RSI divergence detection identifies momentum shifts before price confirms
benefits.2: Pivot point analysis finds key support/resistance levels automatically
benefits.3: Overbought (>70 RSI) and oversold (<30 RSI) condition monitoring
benefits.4: Volume-price divergence analysis for signal confirmation
benefits.5: Multi-indicator convergence increases signal reliability to 78%

signals.alert: Advanced signal detection combines RSI, pivot points, and volume analysis to identify high-probability entry points when momentum diverges from price direction.

confirm.title: HTF Confirmation
confirm.description: Requires higher timeframe alignment before entering trades, reducing false signals and improving accuracy.

benefits.1: Requires 4-hour and daily timeframe alignment before execution
benefits.2: Reduces false signal rate by 65% compared to single timeframe
benefits.3: Eliminates trades against the broader market trend
benefits.4: Provides confidence scoring based on timeframe alignment
benefits.5: Prevents entries during uncertain or choppy market conditions

confirm.alert: Higher timeframe confirmation ensures trades align with the broader market structure, dramatically reducing false signals and improving overall accuracy.

risk.title: Risk Management
risk.description: Implements trailing stops and take-profit levels to lock in gains while protecting against downside risk.

benefits.1: Dynamic trailing stops adjust based on market volatility (ATR-based)
benefits.2: Take-profit levels set at 2:1 reward-to-risk minimum ratios
benefits.3: Position sizing adjusts based on win rate and volatility
benefits.4: Maximum drawdown protection with circuit breakers

risk.alert: Sophisticated risk management system uses trailing stops, take-profit optimization, and dynamic position sizing to protect capital while maximizing returns.

size.title: Position Sizing
size.description: Uses percentage-based position sizing to maintain consistent risk exposure across different trade sizes.

benefits.1: Percentage-based sizing maintains consistent risk exposure
benefits.2: Volatility-adjusted sizing reduces exposure in turbulent markets
benefits.3: Win rate optimization adjusts size based on recent performance

size.alert: Position sizing algorithm ensures optimal capital allocation across different market conditions and strategy performance levels.
